page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, storage-optimized server engineered for data-intensive enterprise workloads requiring direct hardware access. The platform is driven by two Intel Xeon 8559C processors delivering 96 physical cores and 192 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It features 320 MB of L3 cache, comprehensive instruction set extensions including AVX-512 and AMX matrix accelerators, and no virtualization hypervisor overhead.

Memory and internal storage provide massive capacity and throughput. The server provides 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, maintaining a ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. Storage includes 120000 GB of directly attached NVMe SSD space, while external communications are backed by a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps. No discrete GPU acceleration is included on this bare-metal platform.

Benchmark outcomes show top-tier multi-threaded compute, memory, and transactional performance. In stress-ng testing, multi-core CPU throughput reached 171422.45, placing in the top 10%, while single-core performance remained average at 2158.98. Memory bandwidth delivered 577.25 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 238.55 GB/sec for uncached writes. Database and key-value benchmarks produced exceptional figures, registering 37183.63 in PassMark database operations and 214.78 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations.

This hardware density balances high infrastructure resource allocation with specialized capabilities. The dense ratio of 120 TB NVMe storage alongside 1.5 TB DDR5 RAM makes this server ideal for large transactional databases, distributed storage clusters, in-memory data grids, static web content distribution, and large-scale data transformation pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-48xl is a high-density, bare-metal storage-optimized server powered by Intel Xeon 8559C processors. Featuring 96 physical cores, 192 vCPUs clocked at 3.2 GHz, 320 MB of L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 and AMX extensions, it provides top-tier multi-threaded performance. Memory capacity stands at 1536.0 GB of high-speed 6 GHz DDR5, paired with 120000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a 200 Gbps network interface. The system lacks discrete GPUs but achieves exceptional throughput across memory-intensive and data-heavy operations, demonstrated by 214.78 million Redis SET operations per second and over 577 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. Its balanced high-capacity memory, dense local flash storage, and direct hardware access make it well matched for enterprise relational databases, distributed caching layers, massive analytics data stores, and real-time ETL engines.
